# Cully 0.23.0

- **Savings, replay and connection checks follow the agent you run.** `cully savings`, the advisor replay and the impact transcript comparison now read the history of the agent selected by `cully run`, including Codex, and report an explicit "unavailable" for agents whose history Cully cannot read yet instead of silently using Claude's. MCP connection checks go through the selected Claude Code, Codex or Cursor CLI without a model turn; Codex is asked through its own app server. Replay tool and result counts are now consistent across checkpoints.
- **A deployment example for more login methods.** `deploy/login-methods` is a separate Compose example for signing in with a native LDAP directory, Google, GitHub or an OIDC/OAuth provider through mcp-auth's login-method registry, with example configurations and an environment file passed only to mcp-auth. It requires an explicitly selected mcp-auth release that contains pluggable login support; the existing Keycloak setup is unchanged. The OAuth and team deployment guides explain how to choose a method, and CI validates the example's configuration without starting any images.

Update with `cully update --version v0.23.0`, or use the [installer](https://docs.cully.net/installation). Rerun `cully setup` with your original options to refresh installed hooks and skills.

The example contains placeholders only; supply real secrets through your own secret store, never in the JSON or in Git. Cursor's history is still not read for savings or replay, and replay figures remain hindsight proxies. See the [OAuth guide](https://docs.cully.net/oauth) and [token impact](https://docs.cully.net/token-impact).
